violation_type.title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Permitted Before April 25, 2021 & No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing by May 25, 2021 (26 TAC §747.213(b))
violation_type.short_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Permitted Before April 25, 2021 & No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing by May 25, 2021
violation_type.typical_finding: Liability insurance was updated during the inspection. Permit holder did not have Parental Notification of Lack Insurance forms signed by parents for five children registered in care.

finding_variants.text: Liability insurance was updated during the inspection. Permit holder did not have Parental Notification of Lack Insurance forms signed by parents for five children registered in care.
Parents were not notified the operation does not have insurance.
Parents have not been notified in writing the operation does not have current liability insurance.
The provider does not currently carry liability insurance and has failed to report to the parents of each child in care that the operation does not maintain the required liability insurance coverage.
The provider has not notified parents that liability insurance is not carried which was supposed to have been done by 5/25/21 if it was not obtained.
Primary caregiver was unaware that she needed to notify parents regarding liability insurance.
